text: {"reason":"Add a high-confidence gate. Six of eight listed false arbitrations have confidence below 0.70, so this removes those rows while preserving magnitude, exposure, and frozen-horizon checks. V1 has FAR 0.714 and fitness 0.286; the edit targets false positives while protecting recall≥0.8. Two listed false positives at 0.83 and 0.91 remain.","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure) (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15) (> inventory-exposure 500000) (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change)) (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
